uav_models.name: Геоскан Gemini

payload_mass_kg.source: CAT-001C MVP assumption; https://www.geoscan.ru/ru/products/gemini has no additional payload-capacity scalar. Older Geoscan seminar table: https://www.geoscan.ru/themes/geoscan/assets/seminary/geoscan-weekend-2019/%D0%9A%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2.%D0%9C%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BA%D1%88%D0%B5%D0%B9%D0%B4%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%8F.pdf (different historical configuration).
payload_mass_kg.note: Conservative additional payload metadata only, not a certified operating limit. Assumed plausible range 0.25–2.0 kg; 0.5 kg chosen conservatively for this MVP. Not added to solver mass; selected-camera mass remains outside current physics. Revalidate before operational load planning.

airspeed_m_s.note: Maximum horizontal speed, not live working/survey speed.

climb_m_s.note: Vertical maximum used as MVP climb scalar; no detailed launch profile.

descent_m_s.note: Repository section 6.2 explicitly assumes symmetric vertical ascent/descent; descent is an assumption, not independently confirmed passport.

energy_wh.note: Manufacturer battery energy; deterministic aircraft configuration, not fallback.

uav_models.source: Geoscan Gemini specification sheet. mvp_estimates holds kh, kv, kw and turn times, and a 12 m/s airspeed estimate that does not replace the passport 15 m/s. CAT-001B: live physical source is model aircraft.physics; flight_time_s is converted maximum duration; max speed and working speed differ; legacy turn alternatives retained, live_turn_time_s is the live scalar.

survey_speed_m_s.note: Existing MVP uses survey speed = working airspeed, not maximum speed.

reserve_fraction.note: Existing MVP 5% reserve policy, not hardware specification.

takeoff_overhead_s.note: Vertical launch has no additional fixed overhead in existing MVP; h/climb accounts for launch.

landing_overhead_s.note: Vertical landing has no additional fixed overhead in existing MVP; h/descent accounts for landing.

live_turn_time_s.note: Choose conservative 5 s from existing MVP alternatives [5,3,1]; fixed turn penalty.

uav_models.name: Геоскан 201

airspeed_m_s.note: Chosen working speed 25 m/s within 64-130 km/h, not exact midpoint.

descent_m_s.note: Required for descent/landing timing; no confirmed scalar in repository/manufacturer excerpts. Plausible MVP range 1-5 m/s, choose conservative 2 m/s independently of 3 m/s climb. Not a measured parachute sink rate.

nominal_voltage_v.source: Geoscan 201 Russian manual p116; existing committed battery specification.
nominal_voltage_v.note: Nominal pack voltage for the selected 40 Ah battery configuration.

capacity_ah.source: Geoscan 201 Russian manual p116; existing committed battery specification.

energy_wh.note: 40 Ah * 18.5 V = 740 Wh (repository configuration, confirmed Russian manual p116). Older English manual p98 specifies a different 34 Ah battery; that variant is not selected.

power_const_w.note: Existing constant-flight-power approximation; 220 W motor rating is NOT a measured average. 740 Wh / 3 h = 246.67 W, so equality is not claimed.

uav_models.source: Geoscan 201 manual appendix. Flight speed phrase 64-130 km/h is not one number. Engine phrase electric brushless, 220 W stays here; the 220 W flight-power estimate is power_const_w. CAT-001B: live physical source is model aircraft.physics; flight_time_s is converted maximum duration; max speed and working speed differ; legacy turn alternatives retained, live_turn_time_s is the live scalar.

survey_speed_m_s.note: Existing MVP uses survey speed = working airspeed, not maximum speed.

reserve_fraction.note: Existing MVP 5% reserve policy, not hardware specification.

takeoff_overhead_s.note: Existing catapult allowance; ascent h/climb is added separately.

landing_overhead_s.note: Existing parachute allowance plus independent h/descent approximation; no detailed deployment dynamics.

recharge_time_s.source: CAT-001B explicit legacy spare-battery timing assumption
recharge_time_s.note: Required by repeated-sortie timing; no confirmed cycle time. MVP assumes immediate replacement by precharged spare (0 s downtime, not instant battery charging). Nonnegative handling range 0-600 s; choose zero to preserve existing schedule. Spare logistics are not modeled.

live_turn_time_s.note: 180-degree turn approximation: pi * repository rounded radius 110 m / 25 m/s = 13.823 s. Radius/bank are MVP assumptions, not measured turn performance.

payload_mass_kg.note: This selectable 801 entry is the integrated visible/thermal-camera configuration. The 1.5 kg published mass is treated as complete maximum takeoff mass; no separate user payload is represented or added by the live model.

nominal_voltage_v.note: Manufacturer nominal flight-battery voltage; not the controller battery.

energy_wh.note: Manufacturer UAV battery (NOT controller battery): 126.28 Wh, 15.4 V, 8200 mAh, manual p90; replaces unconfirmed repository 90 Wh estimate.
